headline: Widening the training-resolution set from {21,33} to {21,33,101,201} eliminates the monotonic degradation seen with the old checkpoint. Old: near-best at N=33/37 (~7.4%), degrading monotonically to 44.65% at N=1401. New: best at N=45/49 (~2.3-2.4%), then plateaus at ~5.8-5.9% for every N from 401 to 1401 instead of continuing to climb. N=1401 error drops from 44.65% to 5.85% (7.6x reduction).
